messages:
Maya (prod): Heads-up: customer ZedHealth asked for a clear streaming contract that covers SSE vs WS, delta payloads for partial outputs, and explicit termination semantics. They're worried about mobile resume and cost blowups. Can we list launch gates?

Oliver (eng): Ack. Main tradeoffs: SSE simpler (HTTP, easier to proxy), WS supports bi-directional and multiplexing. For resume you need checkpointing info either way.

Priya (runtime): Important: runtime-level guarantees we can offer: ordering, exactly-once vs at-least-once deltas, and whether we send final "finish_reason" as a separate event or inline. Each has perf and complexity implications.

Sam (devex): From SDK side we prefer a single stable shape that works for both transports. Suggest a small delta envelope: { type, token, index, chunk, metadata } and a final event { type: "done", finish_reason: "...", summary_meta: {...} }.

Anya (design): UX ask: clients want partial rendering (tokens show up asap) and a definite final closure. If we use SSE the browser gets events; mobile SDKs prefer an onMessage callback. Need consistent client-visible "done" vs relying on connection close.

Maya (prod): Launch criteria suggestion: 1) defined delta envelope and finish event documented; 2) at least one SDK implements both SSE and WS consistently; 3) perf numbers (p50/p95) for 2k token sessions; 4) graceful fallback behavior documented. Thoughts?

Oliver (eng): Agrees. Also add: determinism for resume token format (opaque string that runtime can parse) and a bounded queue/backpressure strategy (drop or stall, documented).

Priya (runtime): Implementation notes: we can support two resume modes: checkpoint-by-prefix (KV cache id + offset) and event-index resume (stream index + byte offset). Checkpoint-by-prefix is faster but requires cache hits on the server. Event-index is portable but more costly.

Sam (devex): Telemetry gate: we need per-stream metrics: tokens-streamed, peak-inflight, number of resumes, bytes-sent, and finish_reason distribution. This helps detect cost blowups. Also require an opt-in billing guard for beta customers.

Maya (prod): Prioritization: customer asks (ZedHealth, RetailAI) prefer resume and explicit finish reasons. Not all customers need WS. Can we scope MVP to SSE + WS with limited resume (server-supported opaque checkpoint) and full resume as v2?

Oliver (eng): That's doable. MVP: SSE + WS transport parity for deltas, final "done" event with finish_reason enum (completed, truncated, cancelled, error), and an opaque resume_token we issue every N tokens. No client-side patching required. Full resume later.

Priya (runtime): Backpressure: recommend token-level flow-control where client can send a "pause" message on WS or we expose a server-side throttle header for SSE (Retry or X-Stream-Allowed?). Concrete: if queue>Q we return 429-like event and set Retry-After. Need product input on allowed behaviors.

Anya (design): UX: provide explicit example flows in docs: normal stream, truncated session, client-initiated cancel, resume flow (MVP limited). Include guidance for mobile (use small chunk sizes, show latency windows).

Sam (devex): SDK checklist: (1) SSE client for browsers with auto-reconnect logic that treats idempotent resume_token as opaque, (2) WS client with binary delta parsing, (3) tests for finish_reason handling and partial JSON patches.

Maya (prod): Rollout plan idea: private beta with two customers -> collect resume metrics and finish_reason distribution -> expand to general availability behind a feature flag -> then enable billing. Timeline: beta start in 6 weeks if eng aligns.

Oliver (eng): Risks: proxies that buffer SSE may break immediate delivery; need explicit guidance for customers (NGINX, Cloud CDNs). Also consider extra CPU for resume_token validity checks.

Priya (runtime): Ops: add a streaming-sla dashboard (latency, resume success rate) and alerts if resume rate spikes or finish_reason=="error" > 1% over 5m.

Maya (prod): Owners: Oliver -> runtime API + finish_reason enum; Priya -> resume implementation + telemetry; Sam -> SDK examples + docs; Anya -> UX examples. I'll own rollout and customer comms.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary for streaming-proto branch scheduled tomorrow 03:00 UTC.

Sam (devex): Action items: I'll draft the delta envelope examples and add sample code for SSE/WS. /cc @Oliver @Priya

Oliver (eng): I'll scope the MVP wire format and a simple resume_token implementation. Expect PR in 10 days.

Maya (prod): Great. Can everyone add the top 3 unknowns they want resolved before beta? I'll consolidate. :thumbsup:

Priya (runtime): Unknowns: 1) exact resume_token TTL and storage cost, 2) proxy compatibility for SSE in major clouds, 3) acceptable client backoff semantics.

Anya (design): Unknowns: 1) how much latency clients tolerate for partial rendering, 2) how to display ambiguous finish_reason (truncated vs cancelled), 3) how to communicate streaming billing to users.

Sam (devex): Unknowns: 1) SDK surface for pause/resume, 2) tests we need for flaky mobile networks, 3) whether we should default to small chunks for mobile in SDKs.

Maya (prod): Thanks — I'll collate and create a short spec doc and share in #docs. We'll reconvene next Tue for signoff.
